versions.subject: Add t1490 powershell delete volume shadow copie
versions.detection:
selection_obj:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'Get-WmiObject'
        - ' Win32_Shadowcopy'
selection_del:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Delete()'
        - 'Remove-WmiObject'
selection_eventid:
    EventID:
        - 400
        - 403
        - 600
condition: selection_obj and selection_del and selection_eventid
versions.spl: CommandLine="*Get-WmiObject*" CommandLine="* Win32_Shadowcopy*" CommandLine IN ("*Delete()*", "*Remove-WmiObject*") EventID IN (400, 403, 600)
